How this works

Takes about four minutes. Nothing here can be broken.

  • 👆Drag anywhere to turn the world around and see what is behind things.
  • ✦Tap anything that lights up. Six things are hidden on the island. Find all six and it becomes next year.
  • ☰Five rooms along the bottom — the island, a machine that makes your decisions, a printer, a quiz about you, and a postbox for writing back.
  • ←Back is top-left, your phone’s back gesture works, and keys 1–5 jump between rooms.
  • 🔊Sound is the speaker, top-right. There is music.
  • 🎂The cake, top-right, counts down to the third of February.
  • ✦The star, top-right, gives you a different note every time you press it.
  • ♥It remembers what you have found, so you can leave and come back.

2027

All six found

None of this was invented. A cat with a name already picked, twelve valleys on a list, a degree in a city nobody can pronounce yet, and a leg day that apparently counts as fun.

It is a very specific future for someone who claims to be indecisive. The only part still missing is the doing of it — and that starts in November.
